tracking: ADR-0315 slice 2 (E3): the issued-credential list and revoke-by-jti are API-only; the screen (a tab on the Agent credentials page) is posted on #453 for the Governed Designer

gaps.GET /v1/agent-credentials/issued: pages issued agent credentials newest first (filter by audience or grant), each with its stored state, expiry and status index
gaps.POST /v1/agent-credentials/issued/:jti/r: revokes one issued agent credential by jti (free, audited); its status-list entry becomes INVALID
